capabilities.title: WiFi-based spatial sensing: use CSI (channel state information) data to infer room occupancy and motion
capabilities.sourceEvidence: RuView: WiFi CSI sensing for passive indoor positioning without cameras
capabilities.reason: Through-wall occupancy and vital-sign inference creates a high-risk surveillance and consent boundary and also requires hardware-specific CSI acquisition. It is not enabled by Nexus's general IoT visibility lane.

capabilities.title: Passive motion detection without cameras using ambient WiFi signals
capabilities.sourceEvidence: RuView passive detection: no active beacons required
capabilities.reason: Passive motion detection of people without cameras still requires informed consent, retention rules, access controls, and hardware calibration that Nexus does not provide.

capabilities.title: CSI data pipeline: collect from compatible WiFi adapters, preprocess, and feed ML model
capabilities.sourceEvidence: RuView CSI collection script and preprocessing pipeline
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a software intelligence dashboard; hardware-dependent WiFi CSI data collection requires specific adapters and is out of core product scope.

capabilities.title: Real-time occupancy visualization dashboard
capabilities.sourceEvidence: RuView dashboard: live room occupancy map from WiFi data
capabilities.reason: A live occupancy dashboard would operationalize the excluded through-wall sensing pipeline and expose sensitive presence data; a generic IoT page is not sufficient authorization.
